API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIApplication Segment ManagementGets the Application Segment details for the specified ID.
Gets the Application Segment details for the specified ID.
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/application/:applicationId

Gets the Application Segment details for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

applicationId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the Application Segment.

QUERY PARAMETERS
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.

400
401
403
